prompt:
Original photorealistic editorial still life for Teleprompter Pal's dark charcoal website, landscape 16:9. Neutral soft studio daylight with subtle restrained lavender accents, believable matte black equipment, rich real materials, no neon or CGI plastic. Extremely important crop-safe art direction: keep EVERY primary object and its full silhouette together in a compact cluster entirely within the middle 26% of the image width and between 8% and 38% of image height. Zoom out to achieve this. Leave expansive uninterrupted charcoal tabletop and dark neutral room negative space to left, right and below; no significant objects at the edges or lower half. The compact cluster must survive a narrow centered phone crop and a shallow top-aligned desktop crop. No text, logos, brand marks, watermarks, app-specific UI or claims. Absolutely no people, faces, hands, silhouettes, portraits, head-shaped figures, human screen previews, or human reflections. This is a topic still life, not a screenshot or test.
Topic: reading a script naturally near the camera. One black smartphone held landscape in a simple short tripod clamp, two modest cue cards with abstract line breaks but no readable words, and a small clip-on microphone. Compact upper-center grouping, real glass, paper and rubber. Phone front has one physically correct small front camera and abstract script lines only; no head, face, camera-preview silhouette or recording person.
alt: Landscape phone on a tripod beside cue cards and a clip-on microphone.
responsive_method: LANCZOS exports. Phone uses full source at the top of a 900x1600 canvas; thumbnail is a closer central crop. No creative repainting.
